question: What is the address of the cell in the tenth row of the fifth column in an MS-Excel worksheet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**E10.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A** cell reference or cell address is a combination of a column letter and a row number that identifies a cell on a worksheet.**
 
• **ADDRESS can return an address in relative, mixed, or absolute format, and can be used to construct a cell reference inside a formula.**
 
• Example : **ADDRESS(1,1) returns $A$1 ( column is A and row is 1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The CELL function returns information about the formatting, location, or contents of a cell.**

**MS-Excel Worksheets**

 
• The term** Worksheet used in Excel documents is a collection of cells organized in rows and columns**.
 
• **It is the working surface you interact with to enter data.**
 
• **Each worksheet contains 1048576 rows and 16384 columns and serves as a giant table that allows you to organize information.**
